#### PR description:

The process.options.SkipEvents was replaced with TryToContinue in 13_3_X, so there is no need to revive this test. The commented-out use of this configuration in the unit tests is being removed in #51747. 

Related to https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/34322
Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2406
